bio.text: Chellie Pingree was elected in 2008 to represent Maine's 1st Congressional District in the U.S. House, the first woman elected to Congress from that district.
Born in Minneapolis in 1955, she moved to Maine as a teenager, graduated from the College of the Atlantic, and later ran a small business on the island of North Haven.
She served in the Maine Senate after her 1992 election, including as Majority Leader, and from 2003 to 2007 was national president and CEO of Common Cause.
